name: HireBench
intro: HireBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文与 AgentWorldModel-1K 发布数据中的 1,000 个合成环境之一，对应“Coding Graduate Pipeline”招聘场景。AWM 为该场景生成 10 个任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具、样例数据和逐任务验证器。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 四类任务结果, 完成奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强LLM裁判
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；10个招聘任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented LLM judge
intro_en: HireBench is not a standalone benchmark. It is one of 1,000 synthetic environments in the Agent World Model paper and AgentWorldModel-1K release, representing the Coding Graduate Pipeline recruiting scenario. AWM generates ten tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, sample data, and task-specific verifiers for this scenario.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 recruiting tasks
metric_en: Four-class task outcome, completion reward, Environment Error
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10090v3, especially Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, execution-based self-correction, and Appendix Table 15, plus the official Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K scenario and task files. HireBench is not defined as a standalone benchmark: the paper lists ‘HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline’ as a generated scenario, and the released gen_scenario.jsonl maps it to ats_applicant_tracking_system_4. Its ten released tasks cover job requisitions, coding assessments, candidate profiles, submissions, interviews, offers, bulk pipeline updates, and recruiting analytics. The common AWM pipeline expands 100 domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenarios, classifies and embedding-deduplicates them, generates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario, synthesizes SQLite schema and sample state, emits a minimal typed FastAPI/MCP tool interface, and creates task-specific before/after-state verifiers. Components run in isolation and feed errors back for up to five repair iterations. Agent evaluation combines structured database signals with the trajectory in a code-augmented LLM judge and returns Completed, Partially Completed, Agent Error, or Environment Error.
